propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map use unpaginated search_issues calls that silently truncate results at 50 issues, losing all issues beyond the first page
the methods do not paginate correctly because search_issues defaults to max_results=50 and the callers do not advance start_at or detect page boundaries
issue links and comment sync fail silently for large projects because the maps are incomplete, allowing spurious mutations and preventing detection of removals

this is a recurrent defect pattern: get_parent_map had the same bug fixed in a prior change, but get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map were left unpaginated, and a third instance exists in fetcher._iter_pages
the correct paging pattern is to advance by len(batch) and terminate only on empty page, not on short page, because Jira silently truncates maxResults above a server limit
the fix requires extracting a shared _paged_search helper and routing all three methods through it to prevent fourth instance of the same defect
